# rust.test in a workspace of two crates: each report mode, features, a
# failing test that stays failed until fixed, and a whole-workspace run.
[!exec:cargo] skip

# `suites` shows a line per test binary, and cargo's diagnostics only on
# failure.
bit suites
stdout 'suites ▶ cargo test -p calc$'
stdout 'suites ✔ PASS calc \(src/lib\.rs\) \(.*2 passed\)'
stdout 'suites ✔ PASS doc-tests calc'
! stdout 'PASS calc \(src/lib\.rs\)/'
! stdout 'Compiling'
! stdout 'noisy'
stdout 'suites ✔ ok'

# `tests` shows a line per test, and features select the tests that build.
bit tests
stdout 'tests ▶ cargo test -p calc --features extra$'
stdout 'tests ✔ PASS calc \(src/lib\.rs\)/tests::adds$'
stdout 'tests ✔ PASS calc \(src/lib\.rs\)/tests::adds_zero$'
stdout 'tests ✔ PASS calc \(src/lib\.rs\)/tests::extra$'
! stdout 'Finished'

# `verbose` adds cargo's own output as it arrives.
bit verbose
stdout 'verbose │ .*Finished'
stdout 'verbose ✔ PASS calc \(src/lib\.rs\)/tests::adds$'
! stdout 'tests::extra'

bit suites tests verbose
! stdout '✔ ok'

# A failing test shows its panic and fails the run, and fails again until
# fixed.
! bit failing
stdout 'failing ✔ PASS broken \(src/lib\.rs\)/fine$'
stdout 'failing ✘ FAIL broken \(src/lib\.rs\)/sum$'
stdout 'failing ┆ .*math is broken'
stderr 'test target ''failing'' failed'
! bit failing
stdout 'failing ▶ .*previously failed'

# The runner's cp keeps the file's older mtime on macOS, which cargo reads as
# unchanged, so the system cp writes the fix.
exec cp fixed.rs broken/src/lib.rs
bit failing
stdout 'failing ✔ PASS broken \(src/lib\.rs\)/sum$'
stdout 'failing ✔ ok'

# Without `package`, every member's tests run.
bit workspace
stdout 'workspace ▶ cargo test$'
stdout 'workspace ✔ PASS calc \(src/lib\.rs\)'
stdout 'workspace ✔ PASS broken \(src/lib\.rs\)'

-- BUILD.bit --
explicit suites = rust.test {
  package = "calc"
}

explicit tests = rust.test {
  package  = "calc"
  report   = "tests"
  features = ["extra"]
}

explicit verbose = rust.test {
  package = "calc"
  report  = "verbose"
}

explicit failing = rust.test {
  package = "broken"
  report  = "tests"
}

explicit workspace = rust.test {}
-- Cargo.toml --
[workspace]
members = ["calc", "broken"]
resolver = "2"
-- calc/Cargo.toml --
[package]
name = "calc"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"

[features]
extra = []
-- calc/src/lib.rs --
pub fn add(x: i32, y: i32) -> i32 {
    x + y
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    #[test]
    fn adds() {
        assert_eq!(super::add(1, 2), 3);
    }

    #[test]
    fn adds_zero() {
        println!("noisy");
        assert_eq!(super::add(0, 2), 2);
    }

    #[cfg(feature = "extra")]
    #[test]
    fn extra() {}
}
-- broken/Cargo.toml --
[package]
name = "broken"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
-- broken/src/lib.rs --
#[test]
fn sum() {
    assert_eq!(1 + 1, 3, "math is broken");
}

#[test]
fn fine() {}
-- fixed.rs --
#[test]
fn sum() {
    assert_eq!(1 + 1, 2, "math is broken");
}

#[test]
fn fine() {}
